title: Integrated Photonics Technical Leader - Acacia (remote)
locations: Holmdel, New Jersey, United States of America

teaser: Become part of our team as an Integrated Photonics Technical Leader, driving the design, simulation, and testing of advanced photonic components and circuits. Collaborate with a dynamic team to develop coherent optical transceivers and support innovation in high-speed communications. Ideal for experienced professionals in optical engineering or related fields.
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 06/16/2026
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Preferred candidates will be located in Maynard, MA, Holmdel, NJ or San Jose, CA.

Meet the Team

Acacia (part of Cisco) is a market leader in high-speed coherent optical transceivers, pioneering the development of coherent pluggable transceivers. Acacia’s coherent products are deployed by all hyperscalers to connect their Data Centers over distances from a few kilometers to thousands of kilometers and even in submarine networks. The emergence of AI has drastically increased the demand for Acacia’s coherent transceivers. Acacia’s coherent transceivers are also being used in space applications and are expected to be used inside data centers as interconnect speeds continue to increase. Acacia is also entering the PAM4 Client market and is expected to be a key provider of PAM4 solutions, including a 1.6T PAM4 DSP. The Photonic Integrated Circuits (PIC) team is a dynamic group that develops advanced photonics chips for optical communications products.

Your Impact

In this role, you will work very closely with the entire PIC team covering a wide variety of directions, including silicon photonics and III-V device designs, simulation, foundry process development, production tapeout, PIC testing, and production support. You will be responsible for the design, simulation, layout and testing of photonic components and circuits.  You will also work closely with millimeter wave design team, packaging team, and module hardware / software / optics testing team in building complete products. 

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years or Master’s degree with 8+ years or PhD + 5 years of industry experience in optical engineering, electrical engineering, material science, physics or related fields.

Experience with solid-state physics, integrated photonics, and opto-electronics

Experience with photonics numerical simulation principle and tools, such as FDTD, HFSS, COMSOL and etc.

Experience in photonic device process and fabrication

Experience with photonic device layout and tapeout

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with photonic device layout and tapeout

Experience in hybrid integration of different material systems

Experience in photonic devices based on thin-film lithium niobate

Experience with designing, simulating and testing of high speed electronic or optical devices 

Experience with photonic component testing

Experience with large-scale photonic circuit tape-outs in commercial

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
